qualification: Whole owned-vessel state retained across partial inspect rows; solution/lot diagnostics are not extra matter. Atom/formal-charge projection is separate from chromatographic peaks or conductivity. Mass marked known-property only where required values exist; unknown mass inputs are explicit. This does not independently validate distillation enthalpy or energy-budget semantics, partition coefficients or empirical retention times. Held cases are not accepted for merely conserved matter.
